observations: The page number «86» stands at the head of the page, centred, with a rule below it. The page has no signature. L01-L04 end chapter 31 (pp. 81-85, JP2 0113-0117). L05-L06: the heading of chapter 33, in bold, centred, with the reference to the text below it; N02: Suter's heading for the chapter whose Latin title, «Quomodo defectus solis et lunae notari debeat» (p. 26, JP2 0058, L01), names the sun and the moon.
L07-L09 and N03: chapter 32, on the houses, stands in C before chapter 33 (pp. 25-26 of the text, JP2 0057), in N on fol. 56 recto, and O omits it (p. 25, JP2 0057, note 28 and the margin «N 56r»).

L18-L20: the data of the example, set in three columns: the heads «Wahrer Ort der Sonne (bezw. des Mondes) :» and «Korrig. Argument der Breite :» in two lines, «Zeit der Opposition :» centred between them, the values in the line below. Each printed row is one line here, the cells separated by our «|»; the empty cell of L18 gives the first column room and is not printed. The values are those of p. 85 (JP2 0117, L12, L21, L23 and L31).

L21-L30 and N05: the rule of the far and the near distance, the last sentence of the bracketed account of the lunar eclipse in C (p. 28 of the text, JP2 0060, L01-L04: «in ultimo gradu geminorum aut primo gradu cancri», «ultimum sagittarii aut capricorni primum gradum», that is 89°-91° and 269°-271°), and N's correction by a later hand (p. 28, note 1). Checked: 277° 12′ 45″ is not within 269°-271°, so that by the rule of the text («Quod si neutro luna extiterit», p. 27, JP2 0059, L14-L15) both tables are entered. The distance of the moon depends on its anomaly, as N's addition says (far at anomaly 0, near at six signs); the corrected anomaly of the example, 285° 44′ 43″ (p. 85), is 74° 15′ from the apogee.

L19: «(bezw. des Mondes):», the colon set close after the bracket (3 px); «der Breite :», after a thin space (7 px). N08: «Note 1;», the semicolon set close (5 px). L06: «26—28», «73—76», the long dash of the small type of the references (35 and 44 px); L25: «89°—91°», «269°—271°», the long dash of the text (39 and 48 px).

Spaced type, marked {sp:}: «Kh.», «Al-Madjrīṭī», «Ptol.», «Batt.», «Burgess», «Nallino»; italics: «Sūrya-Siddhānta», «Mondfinsternis», «Opposition», «spatio longinquo», «spatio propinquo», «pro spatio propinquo», «pro spatio longinquo». L20: «Rabīʿ II» upright, with the macron and the ʿayn raised; N05: «56r», the r raised.
The other colons and the semicolons stand after the thin space of the edition (11-13 px measured).
